metadata.description: Bulletproof: test discipline for Claude Code, enforced by deterministic hooks instead of the model's goodwill

plugins.name: bulletproof
plugins.description: Test discipline through deterministic hooks: an Exit Lock that blocks `git commit` of code with no green test run, a Guide at session start, and production guards that ask for approval before a deploy or a production database write. It only acts in projects you adopt; every other project is ignored.
